name: agents-md-ancestor-loader
description: SessionStart hook that injects AGENTS.md files from ancestor directories above Codex's built-in project-root boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Injects ancestor AGENTS.md files on session start
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex SessionStart hook that reads AGENTS.md files from parent directories above Codex's detected project root and injects them as additional context. This fills the gap where Codex's built-in AGENTS.md discovery stops at the nearest project root marker such as .git.
defaultPrompt: Load ancestor AGENTS.md guidance for this workspace.
